item.description:
Insight 0.5.0 beta

  • More reliable microphone startup, including when no audio is playing. Direct Core Audio capture and improved audio conversion preserve incoming speech.
  • Clearer first-run permission, download and on-device transcription progress. Listening becomes available when setup is ready; failed setup offers recovery steps.
  • Settings changes stay in draft until Save, with Save, Discard or Cancel when closing. Saved changes apply to the next listening session.
  • Provider failures now appear in the insight feed. Rate limits back off automatically; persistent quota, connection or response failures pause API calls while transcription continues. Stop and Start to retry.
  • Thinking options run from least to greatest effort, with completion budgets matched to the selected mode. Unfinished model replies are rejected rather than shown as advice or saved as notes.
  • Includes Parakeet Ultra on-device transcription, optional experimental LocalVQE echo reduction, expanded provider/model choices and independent prompts for each model and role.
  • Includes the Groq retired-model migration to GPT-OSS 20B and clearer model-unavailable errors.
